podcast.title: First Century Mod
podcast.body: Jake Bugg is identified as one of the "first century mods," indicating a contemporary artist who embodies or is influenced by the mod aesthetic and cultural leanings. "Many first century mods include Jake Bug and Miles Kane of the last Shadow Puppets."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: UK Folk Scene Growth (2010s)
podcast.body: This artist was part of the expanding folk scene in Britain during the 2010s, a movement that grew significantly after Mumford & Sons. "What started with Mumford & Sons in the odds expanded to Laura Marling, Jig Bug, Ben Howard, and of course Ed Sheeran..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
